annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/1396 laying down the rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 as regards the designation of expert panels in the field of medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 234/23
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision designating eleven expert panels plus one additional panel under the EU Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745. It sets rules on advisor appointment, independence and conflicts of interest, a coordination committee, a secretariat, transparency and remuneration. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Designates expert panels in eleven clinical areas, including IVD, plus one additional panel.
Advisors are appointed after a public call, serve three-year terms, and are listed centrally.
Advisors must declare interests and have no industry conflicts.
A coordination committee adopts common rules of procedure; the Commission provides the secretariat.
Names, declarations and opinions are published; advisors are paid 450 EUR per day.
